content:
Noah Kim: quick note ran variant-embed-v2 quant sweep (q4/q6) on longtail-sampling-10k. noticed q4 recall@10 plummet vs fp16 on rare labels (0.70 -> 0.60).
Elena V: ouch. q4 often aggressive. Did you try light per-channel or per-dim calibrations?
Noah Kim: started with per-tensor symmetric. tried per-channel -> q4 recall@10 improved 0.63, still gap.
Marco: Could be per-dim variance collapse. We saw that before with compact models. Try matching per-dim std to fp16 stats after quant.
Noah Kim: ran quick postproc:
```python
# pseudo
q_emb = quantize(model, bits=4, mode='per_channel')
fp_stats = load_stats('variant-v2/fp16_stats.npy')
q_emb = (q_emb - q_emb.mean(0)) * (fp_stats.std / (q_emb.std(0)+1e-6)) + fp_stats.mean
q_emb = q_emb / np.linalg.norm(q_emb, axis=1, keepdims=True)
```
Noah Kim: result: recall@10 -> 0.68, recall@1 improved from 0.28 -> 0.33, silhouette score recovered ~70% of delta.
Gina: nice recovery. How about tail-failure rate (nn sem mismatch) and throughput delta?
Noah Kim: tail-fail dropped from 1.8% -> 0.9%. throughput vs fp16: +20% qps for q4, cost down ~42%.
Elena V: that tradeoff seems promising if tail failures <1%. Can eval-bot run an A/B on 50k simulated sessions with metrics=[recall@1, recall@10, tail-fail, silhouette, nn-consistency]?
Noah Kim: also add a cache-warm vs cold test (microbatch=16) to catch any masking by KV cache.
eval-bot: AB job submitted. run_id=ab-1759004321-1. ETA ~30m. :robot_face:
Marco: Proposed onboarding checklist update: 1) default to per-channel for embed quant 2) mandatory per-dim stat reconciliation step 3) L2 normalize after postproc 4) require tail-fail <1% on longtail holdout before rollout.
Gina: please paste the postproc snippet into the model README and add unit test that asserts recall@10 delta <=1.5 pts vs fp16 on sample holdout.
Noah Kim: done, PR incoming. will follow up with AB results. :thumbsup:
